Getting Divorced? Don’t Let Zillow Decide What Your Home Is Worth.

When a marriage ends, deciding what happens to the family home can be one of the hardest financial conversations.

By Reddy Appraisal LLCOctober 22, 20262 min read

IN THIS ARTICLE

THE SHORT ANSWER

Before agreeing to a buyout or putting the home on the market, ask your attorney what valuation date and report format are needed. Both parties may benefit from agreeing on a qualified, independent appraiser and understanding the report’s intended use.

Online estimates and settlement decisions

When a marriage ends, deciding what happens to the family home can be one of the hardest financial conversations. One spouse may want to keep it, the other may want to sell, and online home estimates can add more confusion than clarity. A Zillow Zestimate can be a useful starting point, but it is not the same as an independent appraisal of a specific property.

What an independent appraiser considers

A residential appraiser examines recent comparable sales, the home’s condition, upgrades, location, and features that an automated estimate may not fully capture. In Tucson and throughout Southern Arizona, things like a guesthouse, a mountain view, or an unusual floor plan can make a meaningful difference. An appraisal can provide a well-supported value opinion for settlement discussions, although the appropriate effective date and appraisal scope depend on the circumstances.

Agree on the intended use and effective date

Before agreeing to a buyout or putting the home on the market, ask your attorney what valuation date and report format are needed. Both parties may benefit from agreeing on a qualified, independent appraiser and understanding the report’s intended use.
